GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll build and deliver autonomous, agentic software development lifecycle capabilities for GitLab's engineering teams. You'll lead technical execution, mentor other engineers, and work closely with Product Managers, engineers, and AI and machine learning partners. You'll turn complex requirements into robust, secure, and performant AI-driven solutions, with a focus on high-quality code, reliable systems, measurable performance, and safe use of AI across the software development lifecycle. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Build autonomous, agentic software development lifecycle features that support team goals and GitLab's product roadmap. 
 Develop and deploy AI agents that automate engineering tasks such as merge request authoring, test generation, and security remediation. 
 Collaborate with Product and AI and machine learning teams to break down complex requirements and deliver solutions iteratively. 
 Write clean, maintainable code and conduct thorough code reviews to support the quality and safety of agentic workflows. 
 Build and maintain orchestration patterns and safety guardrails for AI services. 
 Measure and improve the performance, latency, and correctness of AI-driven features using defined evaluation frameworks. 
 Participate in on-call rotations and debug complex issues involving AI services and autonomous agents. 
 Follow GitLab's security, compliance, and data governance standards while contributing to documentation, playbooks, reusable libraries, and the growth of other engineers. 
 
  What you’ll bring  
 
 Experience building and shipping production-grade software applications, including transferable experience from related engineering domains. 
 Experience with AI and machine learning application programming interfaces, large language models, or agentic frameworks in a web development context. 
 Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Ruby, Go, or Python, along with experience working with distributed systems. 
 Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and developer tools. 
 Experience with testing frameworks, observability tools, and performance monitoring. 
 Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate across functions. 
 Experience writing maintainable code, reviewing others' work, and supporting secure, reliable systems. 
 Ability to mentor junior and intermediate engineers and help them develop their technical skills and understanding of AI patterns.

title: 供应链管理内控专家（北京/深圳）
jd_text:
1、供应链关键节点风险管控，参与供应链品类（服务器、网络设备、部件、机房设备等）的年度、季度、项目采购策略评审，识别策略机制、竞争性、评分规则等方面的风险；覆盖需求、规划、寻源、评标、定标、合同、验收、运营付款的全链路关键节点，对策略合理性、评委独立性、评分规则、定向扩容等特殊场景做独立判断；针对供应链特有场景（供需匹配、齐套交付、备件管理、EOL或EOS、供应商产能波动等）建立事中参与机制；
2、机制建设与制度输出，主导或参与供应链领域的制度、规则、流程建设（如采购策略管理模板、供应商准入与考核机制）；推动关键规则的系统线上化（如评标线上化、指定供应商流程系统化），把规则真正落到执行；沉淀方法论，跨品类拉通复用；
3、供应商管理与舞弊防控，参与长短名单机制、供应商绩效评价、黑白名单拉通、异常行为监控策略；识别利益关联、职责未分离、信息泄漏等舞弊风险点，推动整改；对高风险信号做深挖，输出分析报告和处置建议。

1.英语/教育专业本科及以上学历，具备初中及以上英语教师资格证，雅思口语7.5以上，有CELTA、TESOL等相关认证者优先。
2.对全国小学英语教学内容有深入理解，能够清晰讲解复杂知识点。
3.有大班教学经验，带过千人以上大班的老师优先。
4.有独特的方法和技巧，有鲜明的教学风格，具有课堂表现力和把控力，善于维护师生关系。
5.有亲和力，镜头感强，英语发音纯正，普通话标准，积极热情。
6.有责任心，具有团队合作精神，愿意与同事共同进步。 1.负责小学英语在线大班引流课/长期班授课，80%英文授课，充分备课以完成教学任务，保证高质量的教学内容与互动。
2.按照教学计划，准备和布置作业、批改并反馈学生学习情况。
3.熟悉小学-初中阶段学生特点、校内外学情，配合班主任做好家长服务，通过优秀的服务品质建立家长口碑，为完课率和用户留存负责。
4.参与学科内教学研讨和教研活动，以提升教学质量，承担讲义及教研出版物制作。
5.打造个人学科IP账号，配合出镜做知识分享和产品营销种草，与运营配合进行直播间产品售卖工作。

title: 高级/资深系统策划（永劫无间）
jd_text:
1. 4年以上策划工作经验，至少负责过一款完整游戏的系统和玩法设计；
2. 创新能力强，想象力丰富，并善于实现自己的想法；
3. 系统性思维能力强，逻辑能力严密；
4. 熟练掌握游戏引擎工具，动手能力强，实现能力强，并善于学习和钻研新技术；
5. 热爱动作类、竞技类游戏，精通最近几年的动作类、竞技类游戏大作，有独到的游戏理解；
6. 具有优秀的沟通能力和团队协作能力，富有工作激情和责任感。

加分项：
曾参与过动作类、竞技类游戏的开发，有上线项目优先； 1.参与系统功能和玩法的设计，实现从设计到实现和验证等各方面的内容；
2.负责撰写策划案及需求文档，并跟进完整的制作流程，协调开发各部门之间的合作；
3.优化和迭代游戏系统和玩法内容。

title: UGC编辑器策划（永劫无间）
jd_text:
1.有关卡策划、内容运营，或UGC品类策划经验者优先；
2.是《永劫无间》端游或手游爱好者，有较多的体验时长或一定操作实力；
3.有较强的动手能力，熟悉《蛋仔派对》、《马里奥制造》、《Roblox》等UGC游戏，或War3、Dota2、星际2等编辑器者优先；
4. 对市面上的新玩法、新体验、新话题有敏锐的捕捉能力，冲浪速度快，能快速迎合玩家喜好；
5. 有良好的团队合作精神，较强的沟通能力，抗压能力强，有不错的同理心，能融入团队。 1、设计并跟进UGC编辑器创作相关功能，包括但不限于地图、名片、大厅等场景编辑类功能、可视化编程、timeline等逻辑类功能。
2、跟进UGC官方资产库，以及表现类需求，推动场景品质提升。
3、设计并跟进UGC编辑器教学相关功能，包括但不限于AI创作、教学视频、教学模板等。
4、负责官方OGC玩法设计，对接UGC核心创作者，发布任务，跟进创作进度，指导内容创作，审核并回收。

title: 机器人-资产管理（设备/场地方向）
jd_text:
1、设备资产全生命周期管理

1）建立并维护机器人设备资产台账，实现从采购入库→调配使用→维修保养→报废处置的全链路管理
2）制定并执行设备定期维护保养计划，协调硬件厂商完成故障维修，管控维修时效与成本
3）参与新型数据采集设备的采购评估与选型论证，输出设备性能测试报告与采购建议
4）建立设备借用、调拨、盘点等标准化流程与管理制度，确保账实一致

2、数据采集场地运营管理
1）负责数据采集工厂/场地的日常运营管理，包括场地使用排期、环境维护、安全巡检等
2）对接物业、施工方等外部资源，保障场地基础设施（电力、网络、空调等）的稳定运行
3）参与新场地的选址评估、装修规划与建设推进，确保场地满足多类型机器人数据采集需求
4）建立场地使用管理制度，优化空间布局，提升场地复用率与坪效

3、数据分析与效率优化
1）统计分析设备利用率、故障率、维修周转时长等核心指标，定期输出资产运营报告
2）基于数据洞察，识别设备闲置、瓶颈等问题，提出资源配置优化方案
3）搭建设备/场地管理看板，实现资产状态的可视化与实时监控
4）结合业务产能需求，输出设备/场地资源的前瞻性规划建议
5）管控硬件与场地成本：追踪设备采购、维保、场地租金等支出，通过数据分析识别成本优化机会点，输出硬件/场地成本优化建议；注意：外包人力成本由用工管理岗负责，本岗位聚焦硬件与场地成本 1）本科及以上学历，机械工程、电子工程、工业工程、资产管理或相关专业
2）3年以上设备资产管理或实验室/工厂设备运维相关经验
3）熟悉设备全生命周期管理流程（采购、入库、调配、维保、报废）
4）具备较强的数据统计与分析能力和成本意识，能熟练使用各类数据工具进行多维分析
5）细心负责，具备优秀的流程制度建设与执行推动能力

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    GitLab features must ship successfully across four distinct deployment platforms—Self-Managed, Dedicated, Dedicated for Government, and GitLab.com. Today, developers routinely discover platform compatibility issues late in development, triggering costly rework, delays, and emergency escalations. The Platform Readiness team is building an internal developer tooling capability that embeds platform readiness intelligence directly into GitLab's software development lifecycle to solve this problem. 
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer on the newly established Platform Readiness functional team in Developer Experience, you'll contribute to the systems that enable features to ship successfully across all platforms by building and maintaining agentic workflow components and evolving the platform requirements knowledge base. This is a growth opportunity: you will learn the Platform Readiness team's agentic workflows, requirements schema, and integration surfaces from other engineers and team leadership. You'll work on concrete, high-impact problems while developing expertise in platform readiness automation and AI-driven systems. 
 What you'll do 
 
  Build and maintain agentic workflow components  on the Duo Agent Platform: contribute to the Core Agentic Workflow (DAP flow) and the Requirements Agent; write tests, documentation, and evaluations for agentic-workflow behavior 
  Contribute to the platform requirements knowledge base : add requirements, evolve the schema, and improve validation tooling; work with platform teams to translate their expertise into structured requirements 
  Build integration surfaces  that enable feature teams to engage the Platform Readiness team where they already work: issues, merge requests, design documents, and CI/CD pipelines 
  Collaborate with platform teams  (Infrastructure, Security, Data) to translate their expertise into platform readiness artifacts and domain skills 
  Write clear and concise documentation and evaluations  that validate agentic-workflow behavior and improve assessment accuracy 
 
 What you'll bring 
 Required Experience & Skills 
 
  Software engineering experience  with backend focus 
  Proficiency in TypeScript/Node,  Python, or Golang  
  Comfort reading and contributing to schemas  (YAML, JSON Schema) and structured content 
  Experience with and operational exposure to Kubernetes  and reasoning about failure modes 
  Ability to work asynchronously  and communicate clearly in written form 
  Exposure to and experience with LLM APIs, prompts, or agentic frameworks  (does not need to be incredibly extensive)

title: 资深关卡策划
jd_text:
1、3 年以上关卡设计 / 玩法设计经验，完整参与过至少1款上线项目的关卡开发全流程；
2、对 friend slop games / co-op games 有深入理解与热情，对《R.E.P.O》《PEAK》《How to Fish》等游戏有深入体验，并能准确抓住其核心乐趣和玩家心理；
3、扎实的关卡空间设计与节奏编排能力，能独立完成从概念、白盒、投放布点到体验调优的完整闭环；
4、熟练使用 Unity / 主流关卡编辑器 / 白盒工具，具备基础脚本或蓝图能力，熟悉Perforce/Git等协作工具；
5、有关卡随机化（程序化布局 / Roguelike 结构）或关卡生成工具设计经验；
6、出色的跨职能协作能力，善于沟通，能推动多岗位对齐设计目标并落地。 1、负责局内地图的设计与制作，包括空间路径规划、难度曲线、节奏编排，输出可执行的设计案与高质量白盒；
2、深度参与标杆关卡内容框架搭建，沉淀关卡设计模板与生产流程规范，推动标杆关卡达到"标杆品质、标准难度、多结构储备"的目标；
3、设计随机场景结构的拼接规则，与程序、美术协作推动关卡生成工具、编辑工具（机关 / 交互点生成、投放刷点）、掉落编辑器的落地和完善；
4、负责环境机制与关卡玩法的耦合设计、陷阱与机关布置、掉落物布点（种类 / 数量 / 概率），以及关卡内道具、消耗品的投放规划；
5、围绕情绪起伏与场景奇观，设计关卡高光时刻（合作 / 互动趣味点、多样化的单局随机组合），善于结合美术、音乐音效营造情绪点和氛围体验；
6、跟进玩家测试反馈，能在反馈中识别并思考核心问题解决，下手有支点，排除干扰项，完成关卡玩法体验调优，并能够敏捷得动手迭代落地再验证。

title: 资深特效设计师（无限大）
jd_text:
-有5年以上的游戏特效设计工作经历；大专以上学历；
-设计/绘画相关专业的创新设计思维；
-对于写实的各种动态效果有很好的观察及分析能力；
-熟悉掌握unity3D,3dmax/Maya,AE,PS等其他相关游戏特效制作软件；

-具备良好的性能优化意识；

-参与具体特效设计任务，制定质量标准及规范制作流程，参与审核；
-具备良好的语言表达能力及合作态度。

-具备良好的语言表达能力及合作态度。

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment. 
  Some examples of our projects:  
 
 Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities 
 Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities 
 Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base 
 Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards 
 
  What you will do  
 
 Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement 
 Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs 
 Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates 
 Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact 
 Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows 
 Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation 
 
  What you will bring  
 
 Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption 
 Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity

jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    
  An overview of this role  
 As a  Principal Product Manager , you will shape a critical part of GitLab's AI product direction by helping customers run advanced AI capabilities in environments that match their infrastructure, security, and deployment needs. This role is focused on  custom models and self-hosted AI experiences , where product decisions need to balance model choice, agent-based workflows, platform usability, and operational realities like configuration, infrastructure, and hardware. You will report into product leadership and play a key role in defining strategy, partnering across engineering and design, and helping the team deliver a strong transition and roadmap during an important period of growth for GitLab AI. In your first year, you'll be expected to bring clarity to the product area, guide execution on high-impact work, and help GitLab build a more flexible and effective AI offering for customers who need self-managed options. 
  What you’ll do  
 
  Lead  product strategy and roadmap definition for custom models and self-hosted AI capabilities within GitLab. 
  Drive  discovery, prioritization, and delivery for features that support model flexibility, self-managed deployments, and AI agent orchestration use cases. 
  Collaborate  closely with engineering, design, and other product leaders to turn complex customer and technical needs into clear product direction. 
  Define  product requirements that account for infrastructure, configuration, deployment, and hardware considerations in self-hosted environments. 
  Partner  with internal stakeholders across GitLab AI initiatives to ensure this product area fits into the broader platform strategy. 
  Guide  tradeoff decisions with a strong focus on customer value, technical feasibility, and long-term platform quality. 
  Support  knowledge transfer and continuity as the team grows and evolves, helping new work move forward with context and clarity. 
  Communicate  plans, decisions, and priorities in a transparent way that helps distributed teams execute asynchronously. 
 
  What you’ll bring

3.负责运维运营工作自动化，包括资源管理、变更管理、故障恢复、用户工具接口等。

title: 海外网络规划架构师
jd_text:
1.负责设计和优化全球网络基础设施的网络架构，从网络架构侧提升业务稳定性和可用性；
2.负责基础设施网络性能评估、容量规划、安全评估等，确保网络的高可用性、高性能和安全性；
3.负责全球网络设备的配置标准化，BGP、Anycast路由监控和优化，以及网络覆盖性能调优等；
4.负责与业务团队合作，推动技术创新和流程改进，以满足业务需求和市场变化,提升在该领域的竞争力。

title: 网络交付项目经理
jd_text:
1.负责网络建设项目端到端交付跟进，确保项目按计划实施交付，及时识别和解决项目问题，保障项目的成功实施；
2.负责网络建设流程的设计和优化；
3.负责建设资源管理，包括机架、ODF、出口容量等，与运营商以及机房现场的沟通协调；
4.对一个或多个项目组合进行统筹管理，对项目集工作进行优先排序，协调提供所需资源，完成团队目标。

title: 知名IP海外项目-系统策划-系统玩法方向
jd_text:
1.负责游戏系统设计和优化迭代相关工作，包括不限于养成系统、玩法系统、系统大模块（如公会系统）等；
2.对游戏系统的最终体验和结果负责, 协调研发相关资源, 确保系统本身和关联系统体验, 确保交互/UI, 数值, 美术表现, 功能体验等达到设计预期；
3.负责系统策划执行全流程, 包括从策划案撰写, 跟进, 落地, 测试, 验收到版本呈现及迭代优化；
4.根据海外市场反馈进行游戏活跃内容的优化设计，制定后续优化方案并跟进具体开发。

title: 腾讯云-南区云原生销售-广州/深圳
jd_text:
1.负责腾讯云华南公有云市场的销售工作，包括目标行业客户的开发与维护及跟进，市场策略制定、合作伙伴管理等；
2.聚焦销售，有坚定的执行力，达成公司制定的目标任务和KPI考核目标；
3.独立开拓华南泛互客户，做出市场增量。

title: 3A级开放世界-资深任务策划-演出向(上海)
jd_text:
1.岗位职责；
2.演出设计：理解游戏剧本与世界观，完成演出设计，撰写交互演出、前台演出及过场表现方案；
3.演出制作落地：根据演出设计，利用游戏内资产与工具，在UE叙事编辑器中完成游戏内剧情演出与过场动画的配置与调优；
4.资产统筹与跟进：根据演出设计案拆分所需资产（角色、动作、特效等），对接叙事/美术/关卡团队，跟进制作进度、品质验收与资产品质提升；
5.叙事耦合：与叙事策划配合，将演出部分耦合到游戏整体叙事体验中，并根据整体流程体验持续调整迭代演出内容；
6.镜头优化：跟进并优化迭代游戏局内镜头效果，提升游戏体验；
7.工具维护与迭代：持续使用并跟进演出相关引擎内工具的功能与易用性，与程序 / TA 协作推动演出工具调优，提升研发效率。

title: 3A级开放世界-3C策划-手感(上海)
jd_text:
1.深度参与项目核心3C模块设计开发，包括不限于角色基础移动、不同情况下摄像机表现等；
2.参与摄像机相关规则的设计和落地开发，包括不同状态下摄像机，各种战斗摄像机效果，双目镜头效果等；
3.参与角色的各种移动效果的设计和落地开发，包括攀爬、翻越、滑板等；
4.参与怪物的基础移动规则的设计和落地开发，包括正常人型怪物、四足怪物、特殊BOSS的基础移动规则，以及对应表现开发，对品质有良好的把控能力；
5.参与大世界机关、系统涉及到角色的基础3C相关内容的设计和落地开发，需要有一定的资源拆解和把控能力。

title: 天美-UE5微恐射击新品-市场营销经理
jd_text:
1.负责天美J3工作室UE5微恐射击新品多端市场营销工作，包括营销策略、节点推广和内容营销等，负责制定上线期各节点营销推广方案，统筹线上线下执行；
2.整合内外部资源，统筹和执行包括营销事件、创意素材、内容营销、KOL合作、BD合作、线下活动和公关传播等各个工作模块的整合营销活动，并对项目进度和最终效果负责。

title: 腾讯云轻量云域名解析专家（北京/深圳）
jd_text:
1.负责高性能域名解析服务的核心模块设计、研发与优化；
2.负责基于DPDK的解析数据面能力建设与性能调优；
3.负责系统在吞吐、时延、缓存命中、资源利用率和可用性方面的持续优化；
4.负责现网复杂问题定位分析，建设高可靠、高韧性的基础设施能力；
5.参与技术演进与团队技术建设，推动关键能力沉淀和经验复用。

jd_text:
1、本科及以上学历，3年以上游戏服务端开发经验；
2、具备处理复杂线上问题的经验：性能优化、内存泄漏、容灾容错排查与处理；
3、具备良好的沟通协调能力，能清晰传递技术方案，提升跨团队协作效率； 1、负责服务端系统、活动及玩法框架的设计与实现，对现有系统进行性能分析与调优；
2、对所负责模块的内容生产管线进行梳理，对其中存在的效率、质量等问题，提供改进方案，对跨职能协作与复杂问题攻关；

title: Gameplay策划（无限大）
jd_text:
1、设计能力出众，能钻研核心gameplay机制的各类实现方式和落地表现，有相关经验者优先
2、对动画表现较敏感，了解动作状态机与动作融合相关的知识。
3、有一定的程序基础，能阅读英文文献学习机制实现者优先
3、细心谨慎，工作认真负责 1、设计制作游戏的核心gameplay机制，深度挖掘gameplay的可能性和组合
2、与其他职能配合，根据叙事、关卡等环节的需求制作相应的gameplay玩法功能

title: 高级/资深特效设计师（暴雪/暴雪IP）
jd_text:
1、设计/绘画相关专业，本科以上学历，有5年以上3D游戏特效制作经验，有完整游戏项目经验尤佳； 
2、熟练掌握PS，有手绘基础，能高效制作贴图，有绘制特效设计稿能力者尤佳；
3、熟悉欧美卡通，欧美写实，科幻和风格化相关游戏风格，熟悉同类型风格特效制作；
4、有较强的特效设计能力，造型和色彩经验，有不断学习提升设计的强烈愿望；
5、为人踏实，有强烈的责任感，良好的抗压能力，自驱力强，有不错的学习能力，良好的沟通能力和团队协作能力；
6、爱玩各类游戏，暴雪游戏老玩家尤佳，有强烈的驱动力去提升游戏的整体体验； -擅长欧美卡通/科幻/风格化的特效设计制作；
-熟悉掌握3dsmax/Maya，Blender, AE,PS等其他相关游戏特效制作软件，会Houdini尤佳；
-参与具体特效设计任务，制作标杆效果，制定质量标准及规范制作流程，有审核反馈能力；
-具备良好的沟通能力和团队协作意识；
-进行特效资源的管理和性能优化；

title: python开发工程师

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

jd_text:
1. 资源管理：拓展并维护小红书、抖音、美团等平台的餐饮垂类达人及MCN资源，确保高质量供给与成本优势。
2. 策略制定：基于门店经营诊断（商圈、竞争、品牌形象、阶段痛点），精准匹配达人层级、内容形式及投放节奏。
3. 商务协同：协同销售端进行售前支持，针对复杂需求场景参与客户沟通，提供达人营销方案建议，辅助商务签约。
4. 全流程执行：负责达人筛选、谈判、Brief撰写与审核、内容把控、上线排期、数据回收及复盘。
5. 风控与合规：制定应急预案，应对达人延期、内容翻车、数据不达标等异常；实时跟进平台合规规则（蒲公英/星图），确保内容安全。
6. 数据与优化：识别数据真实性（刷量/水下），分析爆文率、CPE、到店核销ROI，持续优化投放效率。 1. 拥有丰富的小红书/抖音餐饮方向达人资源（万粉以上+爆文案例），熟悉本地生活探店、团购挂载玩法。
2. 具备美团点星包等平台级达人产品的执行经验，了解服务商及MCN合作流程。
3. 具备内容审美与爆款预判能力，能独立撰写高质量Brief并审核输出内容。
4. 拥有扎实的商务谈判与成本控制能力，擅长打包采买、置换合作以降低投入，能有力的支持销售端商务谈判。
5. 具备多项目并行管理能力（可同时统筹多家门店），把控节奏且交付稳定。
6. 有再惠或同类餐饮SaaS/代运营背景，或自带可转化餐饮客户资源者优先。

title: Manager, IT SOX PMO
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As the Manager, IT SOX PMO, you'll own information technology (IT)-specific Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance activities and serve as a subject matter expert for IT general controls (ITGCs) and IT application controls (ITACs). You will be an individual contributor, reporting to the Senior Director, SOX PMO Leader within the Chief Accounting Officer's organization, you'll directly support the Senior Manager, IT SOX PMO in strengthening GitLab's IT SOX program, preparing new and changing processes and systems for SOX requirements, and advancing automation in a high-growth technology environment. You'll combine strategic guidance with hands-on execution by improving current processes, assessing emerging technologies for SOX impact, and applying practical, scalable control practices. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Serve as an IT SOX subject matter expert for ITGCs and ITACs, providing guidance and supporting compliance with SOX requirements. 
 Partner with the business SOX Program Management Office (PMO) to assess SOX readiness for new or changing systems and business processes, and support the annual IT SOX risk assessment. 
 Maintain and improve control documentation, including flowcharts, risk and control matrices, and control inventories. 
 Facilitate IT control walkthroughs and coordinate the remediation of control deficiencies. 
 Coordinate with internal and external auditors throughout the SOX audit cycle, clearly presenting positions and supporting appropriate conclusions. 
 Review System and Organization Controls (SOC) reports and oversee the key report testing program with contractor support, performing hands-on testing when needed. 
 Build cross-functional relationships, including a close partnership with Internal Audit on SOX testing execution. 
 Identify opportunities for control automation, monitor emerging risks and regulatory changes, including those related to artificial intelligence (AI), and help prepare reports and presentation materials on SOX compliance status.

 As a  Senior Product Manager , you will own GitLab's Secret Detection offering and the Vulnerability Research function that produces the detection content across security products. Secret Detection is one of the highest-signal, highest-volume security capabilities on the platform. In parallel, you will own vulnerability research as a product asset rather than a back-office function. The detection rules, advisory data, and malicious package and reference intelligence your team produces are what make GitLab's security scanners worth paying for, and they need to ship on a cadence with measurable quality. 
 This is an outcome-owning role - you will carry adoption, retention, and revenue targets for your area and be expected to explain how your roadmap moves them. 
  Some examples of our projects:  
 
 Push protection and pre-receive blocking that stops a credential before it reaches a repository, without wrecking developer flow 
 Secret validity checking and automated revocation partnerships with major cloud and SaaS token issuers 
 Detection content pipelines that turn threat research into shipped rules, with precision and recall tracked per rule 
 Intelligence-driven detection of malicious packages, dependencies, and references entering the software supply chain

title: 加工部组长
jd_text: 工业（产品）设计工程技术人员 · 本岗位主要负责供应链仓储场内货品二次加工、分拣打包、贴标分装、组货整理等加工工序的现场统筹与班组管理工作，带领加工小组完成每日仓储加工订单任务，把控加工质量、作业效率、现场5S及安全生产，配合仓储入库、出库、盘点全流程工作，保障仓储供应链货品流转高效、规范、零差错，适配仓储物流常态化加工作业需求。三、主要工作职责1.生产加工统筹管理根据仓储每日订单计划、货品出入库安排，合理分配班组人员工作，统筹安排货品分装、裁剪、打包、贴标、复检、规整等仓储加工工序，制定每日班组作业计划，确保按时完成当日加工任务，保障仓储货品流转节奏，不耽误入库、出库及发货进度。2.作业质量与效率管控全程监督班组加工全流程作业，严格把控货品加工规格、包装标准、贴标准确性、分装数量精度，杜绝错装、漏装、混装、标签错误等问题。实时跟进作业效率，及时调整人员分工，解决作业过程中的卡顿问题，提升班组整体加工产能，降低返工率与货品损耗率。3.班组人员日常管理负责加工班组日常考勤、排班、岗前工作交底、作业指导，新入职加工员工的基础操作带教。规范班组员工作业行为，督促员工遵守公司规章制度、仓储作业规范，及时协调处理班组内部工作问题，调动员工工作积极性，维持班组稳定作业秩序。4.现场5S与安全生产管理负责加工区域现场管理，每日整理、整顿作业工位、加工物料、工具耗材、半成品及成品货品，保持加工区域整洁有序，落实仓储5S管理标准。严格执行安全生产规范，监督员工规范使用加工工具、防护用品，排查现场安全隐患，杜绝违规操作，保障班组作业零安全事故。5.数据台账与对接协同每日统计班组加工产量、货品损耗、完工进度等数据，如实填写加工台账、日报表，及时上报仓储主管。配合仓储、物流、采购等相关部门对接工作，同步加工进度、货品异常、物料短缺等信息，协助完成月度仓储盘点、货品核对等工作。6.耗材与设备管理负责加工所需包装材料、耗材、简易加工工具的领用、登记、管控，合理节约耗材使用，降低作业成本。定期检查加工工具、辅助设备的完好状态，发现故障、损坏及时上报报修，保障作业正常开展。7.异常问题处理及时处理加工过程中出现的货品破损、规格不符、订单变更、物料短缺等突发问题，第一时间反馈异常并配合主管制定解决方案，最大限度降低对仓储发货、货品流转的影响。尊敬的劳动者：您可以登录“随申办”微信小程序，进入“乐业上海第一站”模块，通过搜索职位名称或职位编号20261501917716，对该岗位进行投递。 · 5000-7000元/月 · 招9人

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jd_text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. 
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.  Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 As a Technical Program Manager on GitLab's all-remote R&D PMO team, you will own complex, end-to-end programs that are central to our AI-powered DevSecOps strategy. You will drive high-priority initiatives across product, engineering, data, and security teams, transforming strategic vision into executable plans that deliver innovative capabilities like the GitLab Duo Agent Platform and next-generation developer tools. You will work closely with executive leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, serving as the bridge between strategy and execution through clear communication, proactive risk management, and structured program delivery. In your first year, you will independently lead strategic programs, driving predictable execution, thoughtful tradeoffs between quality and speed, and transparent stakeholder alignment. 
  Some examples of our projects:  
 
 Leading the GitLab Duo Agent Platform from GA through enterprise adoption, including customer onboarding, support models, and billing integration for AI-driven capabilities 
 Delivering data-intensive platform initiatives that enhance developer productivity and enterprise analytics capabilities 
 Driving infrastructure modernization and scalability programs that support our growing customer base 
 Orchestrating security and compliance initiatives that maintain our industry-leading DevSecOps standards 
 
  What you will do  
 
 Lead end-to-end technical programs across product, engineering, data, and security, from initial scope through launch and continuous improvement 
 Collaborate closely with executive leaders and senior stakeholders to translate strategic vision into actionable roadmaps and align on priorities and tradeoffs 
 Coordinate distributed teams across time zones using strong asynchronous communication, providing structure, clarity, and consistent status updates 
 Develop and maintain comprehensive program plans, proactively identifying and mitigating risks and dependencies while facilitating decisions that balance speed, quality, and customer impact 
 Partner with customer success and cross-functional teams to refine communication plans, and operational workflows 
 Champion GitLab's values and culture within programs, fostering collaborative excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation 
 
  What you will bring  
 
 Proven experience leading technical program initiatives in product, engineering, data, or security environments, with demonstrated success delivering complex programs from inception through scaled adoption 
 Demonstrated ability to define strategy and create clarity

 As a Lead People Systems Engineer, you'll drive how GitLab's People systems evolve through an AI-first transformation mindset, putting AI to work across everything we build. You won't just support our people systems, you'll build them: owning the code, pipelines, and integrations that keep GitLab's People automation ecosystem running reliably at scale across Workato, Google Cloud, Claude, Workday, and the tools that power our global workforce. title: 骑手支援经理 (Courier Support Manager)
jd_text:
1. Team Management and Performance Strategy
Manage and develop the delivery operations support team, translating logistics strategies into structured action plans and milestones. Responsible for setting clear priorities and resource allocation, establishing and monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), guiding the team in structured problem-solving and decision-making, and ensuring the team consistently achieves its goals.

2. Compliance Governance and Service Quality Control
Fully responsible for end-to-end behavior management and compliance system construction for delivery personnel, including handling violations, grievance management, and quality standard setting. Proactively identify operational risks, monitor delivery service performance, and ensure high compliance and high-quality service delivery from the delivery team.

3. Delivery Personnel Empowerment and Experience Management
Design and implement a full lifecycle management plan for delivery personnel, covering training systems, communication mechanisms, equipment configuration, and engagement enhancement projects. Dedicated to optimizing the delivery personnel's work experience and improving delivery personnel satisfaction, thereby indirectly improving end-user satisfaction.

4. Operational Process Optimization and Product Collaboration

Understand operational pain points and lead continuous improvement (CI) initiatives. Collaborate closely with product and technology teams to drive system function optimization, workflow reshaping, and the implementation of automation tools to improve operational efficiency through technological means.

5. Cross-Departmental Collaboration and Emergency Response

As the representative of the logistics team, establish efficient collaboration mechanisms with cross-functional departments such as customer service, security, and legal. Lead structured responses to delivery-related emergencies and escalation issues, ensuring timely risk reporting and proper resolution.

ABOUT POSTHOG

Product development used to mean manually writing code, running analysis, diagnosing bugs, and rolling out changes using dozens of tools.

PostHog makes products self-driving https://posthog.com/self-driving. It's the only platform that acts like a co-pilot for you (and your AI agents) to do it all – autonomously.

We started with open-source product analytics, launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products https://posthog.com/products, including:

 - PostHog Desktop https://posthog.com/desktop, the only AI devtool that understands your product, not just your codebase.

 - A built-in data warehouse https://posthog.com/docs/data-warehouse, so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

 - PostHog AI https://posthog.com/ai, an AI-powered analyst that answers product questions, helps users find useful session recordings, and writes custom SQL queries.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 450,000 organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

4.具备较强的业务理解力、人际理解和沟通能力，善于整合资源驱动目标达成。

title: 专家/资深游戏策划（在研3A新项目）
jd_text:
1、热爱游戏，游戏经历丰富，有大型开放世界RPG或3A单机游戏经历/项目经历者优先；
2、对战斗模块设计有充足想法者优先考虑
3、耐心仔细，有责任心和自我驱动力。
4、有良好的沟通和合作能力，逻辑清晰。
5、有过UE5大型项目研发经验的优先。 1、设计和实现优秀的战斗模块内容。
2、与其他策划通力合作，深入优化战斗养成和其他相关系统体验。 
3、深刻理解项目的游戏战斗方向，调研市场头部竞品的战斗体验，产出从市面上动作游戏中脱颖而出的游戏体验设计。

title: 游戏战斗策划（无限大）
jd_text:
1.、有2年以上相关工作经验，对游戏有热情，对主流动作游戏有深入体验；
2.、对游戏里怪物行为逻辑，关卡流程有一定思考和了解；
3、有敬业精神，热衷游戏开发，有良好的团队协作精神，积极主动。 1.配置角色的战斗技能，战斗AI；配置关卡流程中怪物的行为；
 2.根据给出的人物设定，独立设计战斗表现；
 3.发现战斗体验上可以优化的点，并推动迭代。

title: 游戏数值策划（无限大）
jd_text:
1.有一定的经验，至少负责过一款完整游戏的数值策划；
2.数学能力强，系统性思维能力强，建模能力强，头脑灵活，思维敏锐；
3.具备强大的逻辑分析能力和设计调整能力；
4.熟练掌握游戏引擎工具，动手能力强，实现能力强，并善于学习和钻研新技术；
5.热爱二次元游戏，精通最近几年的二次元游戏大作；
6.具有优秀的沟通能力和团队协作能力，富有工作激情和责任感，能承受高强度的工作压力。 1.参与数值框架和系统实现，为玩家呈现最核心的游玩体验；
2.为战斗内容、经济系统等搭建充分而合理的数值体系；
3.赋予角色、怪物以专业而又符合游戏性的数值，并使用高效科学的方法保持平衡；
4.用公式和体系把控经验和成长曲线，规划游戏进程。

title: 游戏关卡策划（永劫无间）
jd_text:
1.三年以上工作经验，熟练掌握整个游戏产品的开发工作流程，对美术和程序的工作有一定了解；
2.对于游戏引擎（Unreal，Unity，CryEngine等）的关卡编辑工具、流程图工具有一定的使用经验；
3.热爱ACT与生存类型游戏，有丰富的相关游戏经历；
4.能从玩家体验的角度出发去发现和解决问题；
5.具有良好的设计能力和创新能力，具有想象力和创造力，以及严密的逻辑思维能力。 1.设计并制作极具表现力和游戏性的对抗型地图与玩法；
2.与美术、程序和其他策划紧密合作，保证玩法和关卡的质量；
3.参与到测试和评估中，定位bug，提出反馈和修改建议，进行优化迭代；
4.随着游戏的不断开发，保证新的游戏内容和原有的玩法机制之间的契合融入。

title: 游戏战斗策划（永劫无间）
jd_text:
1.2~5年游戏策划经验，熟练掌握整个游戏产品开发工作流程，对程序和美术的工作有一定了解；
2.热爱动作类、竞技类游戏，有丰富的动作类、竞技类游戏经历；
3.具有优秀的沟通能力和团队协作能力，富有工作激情和责任感，能承受高强度的工作压力；
4.具备丰富的想象力与创造力，以及严密的逻辑思维能力，善于规则设计。

有永劫无间游戏深入体验者优先。 1.参与设计游戏中的各种功能和玩法，协同程序、美术和测试等相关团队完成游戏开发；
2.根据整体规划的要求，负责游戏内画面表现、动态效果、战斗体验等诸多内容的设计和执行；
3.负责PVP搜撤玩法的持续迭代与更新，包括玩法规则设计、体验优化及版本内容规划；
4.跟进PVP相关内容的落地实现，与程序、美术协作推进，保障设计还原度；
5.负责PVE Boss设计，包括行为逻辑、招式节奏、阶段设计等，并跟进落地实现；
6.负责PVE战斗玩法设计，策划关卡节奏与战斗体验，持续丰富PVE内容池。

title: 游戏玩法策划（无限大）
jd_text:
1、本科以上学历，2年以上优秀玩法、任务策划经验；
2、游戏经验丰富，对于各类开放世界游戏体验深入，对于各类游戏的玩法都有独到见解
3、有突出的创造能力，动手能力，文案审美者优先。 1、根据项目要求，负责游戏内的各种体验向玩法、地图玩法任务的设计和制作；
2、设计推进各类玩法制作所需的功能和机制；
3、与美术和文案共同协作，提升玩法任务的表现和代入感；

title: 游戏关卡策划（诡影藏锋）
jd_text:
1.本科及以上学历，2年以上游戏关卡设计经验；
2.至少参与过一款成功上线的拥有复杂关卡设计的重度游戏；
3.熟练使用过任一关卡相关编辑器和引擎工具；
4.热爱游戏，熟悉市面上各类主流经典游戏的关卡、玩法设计精髓；
5.有良好的团队合作精神，较强的沟通能力，抗压能力强。 1、设计和实现优秀且创新的关卡内容；
2、能够使用各类软件搭建场景白模，完成关卡流程原型；
3、与世界观策划合作，结合视觉风格和核心美术概念，充分利用核心玩法逻辑，形成每个系列关卡核心的视觉感受和体验流程，创造有吸引力的用户体验和独特关卡风格；
4、与程序合作，制作、维护并优化关卡编辑器。

title: 游戏载具策划（无限大）
jd_text:
1. 在具备载具功能的开放世界游戏开发过载具相关的功能、玩法
2. 对手感设计有较为深刻理解,具有极高的品质要求和创新思维,对游戏细节与体验敏感
3. 有良好的团队合作精神，较强的沟通能力，抗压能力强 1.负责载具相关的gameplay内容的设计和制作，设计载具相关任务中需求的机制与玩法
2.保障载具gameplay机制与游戏的其他核心gameplay机制的设计逻辑的一致性
3.深入优化gameplay内容的手感与综合表现
4、根据叙事、关卡等环节的需求，利用Gameplay内容生产完整的玩法任务原型

title: 游戏文案策划（诡影藏锋）
jd_text:
1. 具有3年及以上的RPG游戏行业从业经历； 
2. 能和美术合作，将世界观落地到美术效果层面； 
3. 专业不限，以中文写作/戏剧影视/数字媒体类/美术相关专业为佳，有创作经验者优先； 
4. 具有不错的写作功底，口头沟通表达能力好； 
5. 逻辑能力强，有较强的主动性和责任心，自我管理较好； 
6. 爱好动漫影视，有较多的RPG单机\网络游戏经验。 1. 设计及完善游戏IP和剧情世界观，场景规划、主题氛围设计等，与美术沟通协作实现； 
2. 角色设计规划，包括角色剧情、外观、技能包装及对应特效包装等；
3. 各类系统、玩法、副本、活动等整体世界观文案包装，并与负责同事沟通合作； 
4. 剧情任务、系统引导、基础脚本动画等设计制作实现。

jd_text:

title: 智能硬件电池 Pack结构工程师
jd_text:
1. Pack结构方案设计：负责电池Pack结构总体方案设计（箱体/上盖/托盘/模组支架/端板/紧固件/密封/防护等），输出结构架构、关键尺寸链与接口定义。
2. 设计与工程图输出：使用结构设计软件工具完成建模、工程图、装配关系、公差与关键特性定义，确保可制造/可装配/可维护。
3. 熟悉两轮车的电池Pack结构，具体包括
1)空间与集成：熟悉两轮车车架/踏板/座桶/中置等布置约束，能完成Pack与整车的安装点、受力路径、维修可达性与接口定义（含线束走向、继电器/保险/充电口等结构协同）。
2)轻量化与成本平衡：能在续航与成本目标下，主导材料与工艺取舍（铝/钢/工程塑料/复材），推动零件合并、工艺整合、降本并量化收益。
3)防水防尘与耐候：面向雨淋/涉水/泥沙/高湿/温循/盐雾，能主导密封体系设计（密封面、压缩量、公差链、排气/泄压与防水的矛盾处理），并对IP目标与验证负责。
4)振动冲击/跌落可靠性：熟悉两轮典型工况（路面冲击、共振、侧倒/跌落）和换电典型工况（装卸冲击），能制定结构可靠性策略并推动仿真与试验闭环（模态、随机振动、冲击、跌落等）。
5)快换/换电场景（如适用）：理解换电Pack的插拔寿命、定位导向、防呆、锁止/防盗、把手与人机、快速密封等设计要点，能主导关键机构与公差链设计。
6)安全结构：能将热安全需求落到结构（隔热阻燃、泄压导流、绝缘与爬电间隙、结构防护），并与电芯/热管理协同形成可验证方案。
4. 面向制造设计与成本优化：推动可制造性/可装配性设计评审，优化零件数量、工艺路线与装配节拍；进行成本拆解与降本方案落地。
5. 样件试制与问题闭环：支持样件试制、装配导入、工装夹具需求定义；对试制/测试/量产问题进行定位分析，推动设计改进与版本管理。
6.量产导入：对接供应商完成材料、工艺（冲压/焊接/压铸/挤压/注塑/粘接/密封等）评审与验证；支持量产导入活动。
7. 测试验证与标准符合：参与结构相关测试计划制定与执行（振动、冲击、跌落、挤压、热扩散相关结构验证等），确保满足行业/客户/法规标准等。
8. AI能力建设：在工作中使用通用大模型及生成式AI进行生产性工作，协助团队探索AI辅助硬件结构开发方面的相关应用。
9. 技术文档与跨部门协作：输出设计说明、失效模式分析输入、变更记录、试验报告总结等文档；组织结构评审并推动决策落地。 1. 教育背景：本科及以上，机械设计/车辆工程/材料/机电等相关专业。
2. 工作经验：3年以上电池Pack结构开发经验（或动力/储能相关结构件开发经验），有从概念到量产的完整项目经历优先。有两轮车电池pack开发经验优先。
3. 专业能力：熟悉电池Pack结构组成与关键设计点：箱体/上盖密封、模组固定、热管理接口、绝缘与爬电间隙、泄压与防护、轻量化等。熟悉常见材料与工艺：铝合金/钢/塑料/复材；冲压、焊接、压铸、挤压、机加工、注塑、粘接、密封等。熟悉公差分析、紧固连接（螺纹/铆接/焊接/粘接）与装配工艺。
4. 工具能力：熟练使用至少一种三维设计软件工具与二维出图规范；具备基础有限元分析能力（强度/模态/振动），能与仿真团队高效协作。
5. 工程化与问题解决：具备系统性问题分析与闭环能力，能在试制/测试/量产阶段快速定位结构问题并推动改进。
6. AI能力：了解通用大模型的基本原理，了解AI行业最新进展，具有使用生成式AI输出工作文档的经验，具有使用AI辅助进行生产性任务的经验。有使用Open Claw类型AI工具的经验优先。
7. 沟通协作：能与电芯、电池管理系统、电气、热管理、工艺、质量、供应链等多团队协作推进项目。
8. 通用素质：结果导向、严谨细致、对安全与质量有敬畏心；能在多项目并行下推进关键节点。

 Experience mentoring engineers through pairing, code review, and technical feedback.

  An overview of this role  
 As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you'll shape how candidates experience GitLab from first touch through offer and handoff to our People Operations team. You'll be a key partner to Recruiters, hiring managers, and recruiting leadership, helping them execute hiring plans, coordinate interviews, and maintain accurate, transparent processes in our applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. You'll act as a brand ambassador who embodies our values in every interaction, ensuring candidates receive timely, thoughtful communication and a consistent, high quality experience across a high volume of roles. You’ll focus on building strong relationships with hiring teams, improving and standardizing coordination workflows, and supporting GitLab's goal of hiring a qualified, diverse, and motivated team in our all-remote, global environment. 
  What You’ll Do    
 
 Collaborate with Recruiters, hiring teams, and Recruiting leadership to understand and execute the hiring plan for each job requisition. 
 Coordinate with Recruiters to maintain accurate, up-to-date hiring process information in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories. 
 Manage candidate scheduling and act as the Recruiting Coordinator to organize interviews and keep hiring processes running smoothly. 
 Ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and engaging communication at each stage of the hiring process. 
 Help manage candidate traffic for all roles, monitoring pipelines and flagging issues or bottlenecks to the recruiting team. 
 Create and stage employment contracts for candidates receiving offers on behalf of hiring managers and Recruiters. 
 Partner with People Operations to create a seamless handoff for new team members joining GitLab. 
 Promote GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction, acting as a brand ambassador for potential team members. 
 
  What You’ll Bring   
 
 Experience supporting end to end hiring processes in partnership with recruiters and hiring managers, ideally in a fast paced or high volume environment.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.    An overview of this role 
 The Trusted Agentic Development team sits within GitLab's Developer Experience group and builds the platforms our own engineers rely on every day. GitLab engineers increasingly build software with artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Agents generate code and tests in seconds, so speed is no longer the constraint. Confidence is. Agents can produce a passing test suite for software that doesn't work as intended, and a reviewer may not be able to tell the difference without redoing the work by hand. 
 As Engineering Manager, Trusted Agentic Development, you'll build and lead the team that closes this gap. You'll help define what validation means when the author is an agent and make the feedback loop fast, automatic, and trustworthy. You'll point the team at the right version of an open problem and earn adoption across GitLab by building the best path, not by mandating a process. 
 
 Validation that confirms agent-generated code does what was intended, so a passing suite means a working feature and not just a satisfied proxy. 
 Mid-loop feedback that helps an agent self-correct toward working software instead of green assertions. 
 Language-aware approaches under one shared model of what "trusted" means, starting with Rust, Ruby, and Go, while allowing the right technique to differ by language. 
 Real measurement of whether engineers trust and adopt the path, with findings fed directly back into the platform. 
 
 What you'll do 
 
 Build and grow the team by hiring and developing engineers who practice agentic development, and create a culture that treats this as an open problem to solve rather than a process to enforce. 
 Set direction in an undefined space by partnering with your team to shape the technical approach for validating agent-built software. 
 Keep the team focused on the highest-impact version of the problem rather than the easiest one. 
 Earn adoption by building relationships with engineering teams across GitLab, learning how they work with agents today, and creating a platform they choose because it makes them faster and more confident. 
 Measure engineer adoption and trust through real usage, treat adopters as design partners, and use findings to prioritize where confidence is breaking down. 
 Stay close to the technical work by engaging in architecture and design discussions, reviewing proposals, and keeping your judgment current as agentic development changes. 
 Run the team with clear goals, direct feedback, honest performance management, and ownership of complex work from planning through completion without relying on a dedicated program

 Senior Engineering Managers at GitLab own outcomes for a defined engineering domain, build and grow the team that delivers them, and are trusted to operate with significant autonomy against a clear mandate. 
 This Senior Engineering Manager role focuses on driving non-linear productivity by building and leading a small, hand-picked team of engineers who find and fix the highest-leverage friction points in GitLab's own SDLC. Rather than incremental team management, this is a 0 to 1 team-building mandate. You will personally recruit 4 exceptional engineers, define how they work, and drive them through a root-cause, shift-left approach to engineering productivity, measured in system-level metrics (MRPM, pipeline success rate, pipeline latency), not story points or activity. 
 You will act as a bridge between the pilot squad, engineering managers whose teams are affected by friction points, and leadership, ensuring the team's fixes deliver durable, measurable value before any of it is proposed as a permanent function. 
 This role reports to a VP-level engineering leader. 
   What you'll do   
 Vision & Strategy 
 
 Define and continuously refine the operating model for the non-linear productivity pilot: what "friction" means, how it's diagnosed, and how fixes are prioritized against the three system-level metrics. 
 Identify and prioritize non-linear productivity opportunities (step-change fixes rather than incremental gains) across the SDLC, including flaky tests, review latency, pipeline reliability, tooling gaps, and context loss for both human and agentic contributors. 
 Translate an intentionally broad, ambiguous mandate ("find the friction, fix it at the root") into a concrete, time-boxed roadmap with defined milestones for a 3-month pilot window.

 As a Senior Software Engineer on GitLab's Authorization team, you will own significant parts of the system that decides what every user, token, and automated agent can access on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. 
 Today that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a YAML catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every API request. You will work on the permission model itself (fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and REST surfaces that enforce them). You will also help move that model onto GitLab's next-generation authorization stack, which pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine using Zanzibar-style relationship tuples and Cedar policies. The monolith already loads that engine in-process and can reach it over gRPC. 
 Some examples of our projects: 
 
 Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and by our new authorization service 
 Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources and more kinds of principal, including the service identities behind AI agents

 Design and ship authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith, where a single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks. 
 Own a workstream end to end. Problem definition through feature-flagged rollout, dual-run verification, and cleanup. 
 Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles, and keep the permission catalog coherent as it grows. 
 Extend and harden authorization enforcement across GraphQL and the REST API. 
 Refactor long-lived policy code so both the monolith and our new authorization engine can evaluate it, without changing behavior for existing customers. 
 Improve the reliability, performance, and security posture of existing authorization systems, including paying down permission-model debt. 
 Partner with the authentication, platform, AI, and modular-service teams on interface contracts as authorization moves toward a shared service. 
 Drive technical decisions in writing. Design docs, architecture decision records, and code review, in a fully asynchronous organization.

 Significant experience building and operating production Ruby on Rails applications.

 As Engineering Manager, Database Change Management, you'll lead a remote backend engineering team in the Database Excellence stage.    Lead   a distributed team of backend engineers working fully asynchronously across time zones.

   Protect   the replatforming program's critical path by limiting production interruptions for engineers focused on it while meeting the team's operational commitments. 
   Coach   engineers from intermediate through senior levels, supporting their growth, ownership, and impact. 
   Run   the team async-first through written decision records, visible priorities, and management practices that work when team members share few or no working hours. 
   Partner   with Distribution, Quality Assurance (QA), database framework teams, Database Architecture, Database Automation, and infrastructure leadership. 
   Represent   the team's capacity, priorities, risks, and delivery status to senior engineering leadership. 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
   Engineering management experience   leading remote, distributed teams across many time zones, including team members with little or no overlap with your working day.

jd_text:

Co-create the future with us  as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. 
 * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.     An overview of this role  
 Site Reliability Engineers keep GitLab's user-facing services and production systems running reliably at scale. They combine software engineering with operational excellence, applying sound engineering principles, automation, and continuous improvement to build, operate, and evolve our production infrastructure. 
 This is a single application for Site Reliability Engineering opportunities across Infrastructure Platforms. Rather than asking you to choose the right team or level upfront, we evaluate your skills holistically and match you to the opportunity that best aligns with your experience and our hiring needs. We hire Site Reliability Engineers from Intermediate through Senior Staff across multiple Infrastructure Platforms teams. 
 We don't expect every candidate to have experience with every technology in our environment. We're looking for engineers with strong technical fundamentals, a growth mindset, and the ability to learn quickly. We'll support you in becoming successful with GitLab's tools, systems, and ways of working. 
   Please note: This position is open to candidates based in the United States and Canada only. Candidates based in the United Kingdom can apply to this posting:   Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Platforms — UK (Intermediate to Senior Staff)   
  How our SRE hiring works  
 Because this is a single application for SRE roles across Infrastructure Platforms, our process is built to evaluate you once and match you well, rather than interviewing separately for every team. 
 
  Recruiter Screen:  A conversation about your background, what you're looking for, and the level and teams that fit, so we can point your process in the right direction. 
  Core Technical:  The shared assessment every SRE candidate takes, regardless of eventual team. A low-stress, collaborative discussion covering system architecture and incident review. 
  Hiring Manager Interview:  A conversation about ownership, judgment, execution, collaboration, and growth, the non-technical signals that make an SRE effective at GitLab. 
  Peer Technical:  Team-specific depth, run by SREs from the team you're most likely to join, focused on the problems that team actually works on. 
  Skip-Level Interview:  A conversation with a senior leader on values alignment, and how you'll work across teams. 
 
 After your interviews, we consider your performance alongside our current hiring needs to confirm the level and team where you'll do your best work. Interview results are a major factor, and final placement also reflects our active hiring priorities at the time.

title: 高级/资深游戏配乐师
jd_text:
1、三年及以上工作经验，有完整3A项目及配乐方面知名项目经验者（尤其是国外同类工作经历者）优先；
2、音乐写作、制作水准能达到雷火音频配乐的平均水平——具体水准请参考雷火音频过往原声OST。对游戏音乐有良好的鉴赏品位，对各种风格的需求能够准确并快速把握，具有优秀的作曲、编曲及混音能力，能在既定时间内高质量并独立完成成品音乐的制作；
3、在音乐制作领域“一体机”者优先。熟练掌握一款DAW并能稳定高质产出游戏配乐（在有无实录的条件下均能胜任），对各种原声乐器（尤其是管弦乐和各类民乐）在MIDI制作和实录中的应用、常用效果器的运作原理与使用有深入的理解和实践经验；对管弦原声类配乐、歌曲混音、游戏音乐动态混音有深入经验的优先。
4、良好的沟通及团队合作精神，为人正直，积极主动，有自驱力，能在压力下工作； 
5、本科或本科以上学历（优秀者可以放宽到大专以上学历），有良好的英语或日语能力者、国外留学背景者优先考虑。
6、能至少熟练使用一款声音引擎（例如Fmod，Wwise等）做出较为复杂的音乐设计，至少使用过（例如Unity，Unreal等）一款引擎。并具备独立Debug的能力。对音效、语音等其他音频工作内容和流程有了解。有过类似音频QA、技术音频经历的优先。
7、具备独立开发声音引擎相关代码技能的优先。 1、为游戏场景、副本、CG、PV、剧情歌等内容的制作音乐
2、结合游戏声音引擎，为游戏音乐设计播放机制并与其他职能及外包深度协作

 This role is not a typical infrastructure operations role. As Manager, Engineering, Git & Gitaly Operations, you'll lead the team responsible for the infrastructure layer underneath Git at GitLab: the open source Git project itself, Gitaly, GitLab's Git storage and remote procedure call layer, and the services that make Git perform at enterprise scale. 
 Git and Gitaly are core to GitLab. If they go sideways in production, they affect everything downstream, including continuous integration, code review, and deployments.  You'll build and develop a team with deep platform expertise and strong operational judgment. You'll partner across engineering groups to shape how Git and Gitaly operations evolve as the platform grows.

 Build and lead a team with deep platform expertise in Git and Gitaly, hiring and developing engineers who can operate this infrastructure layer with strong operational judgment. 
 Own production reliability for Git and Gitaly across GitLab's full deployment footprint. 
 Drive incident management, root cause investigation, and postmortems with the technical depth to distinguish a Git internals problem from a generic infrastructure problem. 
 Design and operate Git and Gitaly service models that work across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS, with a clear view of which elements are common and which must differ between them. 
 Maintain cloud-agnostic architecture and tooling decisions, avoiding designs that assume a single hyperscaler's primitives. 
 Partner with the teams that own each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks. 
 Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model. 
 Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers.

 Familiarity with GitLab's product and deployment models, and how Git and Gitaly support repository operations across self-managed, dedicated, and SaaS environments.

 GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer. 
 You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers. 
  Why this role exists  
 Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability. 
 Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate.  GitLab.com is being rebuilt as a horizontally scalable cluster. Two primitives make that possible:  Organizations , the tenant boundary that makes a customer's data a single addressable, portable unit, and  Cells , independent GitLab instances that host those Organizations and can be provisioned on demand across clouds and regions. 
 The target is a 100x increase in headroom for GitLab.com, delivered without customers ever seeing a cell. Same domain, same URLs, same product — a substrate underneath that scales by adding capacity rather than by negotiating with a single database. 
 The boundary we are building is worth more than the scale it unlocks. An isolated Organization can guarantee where its data lives and what travels with it. That turns data residency, regional control, in-region AI and search compute, and enforceable tenant-level policy into product capabilities rather than deployment exceptions. It is the foundation for a class of enterprise and regulated-market offerings that a shared-instance architecture cannot support. 
 We are hiring a Director of Engineering in India to lead this charter. You will build and run the engineering organization that takes Cells from first production migrations to the default way GitLab.com operates.

 Customer Organizations running on cells in production, migrated cleanly and on schedule.

关于TikTok
TikTok是一个覆盖150个国家和地区的国际短视频平台，我们希望通过TikTok发现真实、有趣的瞬间，让生活更美好。TikTok在全球各地设有办公室，全球总部位于洛杉矶和新加坡，办公地点还包括纽约、伦敦、都柏林、巴黎、柏林、迪拜、雅加达、首尔和东京等多个城市。

为什么加入我们
与团队共同激发创造：创造是TikTok的核心。不管对于TikTok产品还是团队本身，我们都希望能激发更多想象力，为自己、平台、我们所服务的社区以及社会带来更多价值和影响。
在有挑战的事中成长：在TikTok，你能够参与非常有挑战性的项目，一起做出突破行业、有全球影响力的事。这里有数以亿计的用户，在等你用新技术、新想法为他们带来新的体验。我们从不安于现状，对我们来说，每一个挑战，无论多么困难，都是一个学习、创新、和成长的机会。
工作方式和文化：我们鼓励务实解决实际问题、在每件事上追求极致，希望大家始终像“创业第一天”那样做事。公司文化多元兼容，同事之间像同学一样平等相处，机制敏捷灵活，希望更好地激发每个人的创造力。
优秀的人能获得认可与回报：优秀人才能够和公司共同成长，什么时候加入都不晚。我们也进一步加大了激励区分度，让优秀的人得到认可和回报、承担更多重要项目，充分发挥潜能，脱颖而出。
欢迎加入我们！

1、负责影响亿万用户的国际化短视频产品的C端产品设计工作，承担主架构方向的产品设计；
2、能根据一些初期的产品想法，从概念深入细化，探索能满足用户需求的方案，支持产品创新；

jd_text: 【工作内容】-负责自动化设备低压电气控制柜的内部元器件装配、接线及布线工作，确保电气连接符合设计规范与安全标准；-根据电气原理图、接线图及工艺文件，独立完成电气箱体的组装、配线、标识及调试工作，保证线路布局合理、整洁、牢固；-熟练看懂电气图纸，能够准确识别电路逻辑关系，对控制柜中的PLC输入输出信号、继电器、接触器、断路器等元件进行正确安装与接线；-参与设备现场安装与调试，协助解决电气系统运行中出现的故障问题，具备快速排查和处理电气异常的能力；-配合项目工程师完成电气装配过程中的技术改进与优化，提出合理化建议以提升装配效率与产品质量；-严格执行安全生产规程，落实“三检制”（自检、互检、专检），确保电气装配质量达标并满足客户验收要求；-按时完成每日工作任务，保持工作区域整洁有序，配合团队完成跨部门协作任务，保障生产进度。【任职要求】-身体健康，无妨碍从事本岗位工作的疾病或生理缺陷；-具备中技或中专及以上学历，电气类相关专业优先；-持有有效的电工操作证（即电工上岗证）及低压电工证，证书在有效期内且可查验；-具有2年及以上自动化设备电气装配或维修工作经验，熟悉PLC控制系统基本原理，能独立完成电气控制柜的装配与调试；-熟练掌握电气图纸阅读能力，能够根据电气原理图准确完成接线、查线、故障排查等工作；-具备良好的沟通协调能力、责任心强，能适应长白班工作制，每周单休，服从工作安排；-工作认真细致，具备较强的服务意识与团队合作精神，能承受一定工作压力。【薪酬福利】-依法缴纳五险一金，享受国家法定节假日及带薪年假；-提供免费工作餐，工作环境良好，管理规范；-定期组织技能培训与职业发展指导，为员工提供晋升通道。尊敬的劳动者：您可以登录“随申办”微信小程序，进入“乐业上海第一站”模块，通过搜索职位名称或职位编号20261601917613，对该岗位进行投递。 · 6000-8000元/月 · 招9人

title: J3-UE5微恐射击-视觉设计师（美宣）
jd_text:
1.负责游戏KV/KA等美术内容从概念到落地的设计工作；
2.负责前期美学探索，风格定调及提案；
3.与内外部配合完成上述内容的落地工作。

title: 3A级开放世界-游戏视频导演（综合）(上海)
jd_text:
1.负责在项目明确游戏视听需求后能自行分解项目工作和制定项目排期计划，确保按计划完成制作目标；
2.负责游戏内剧情过场、展示动画和PV的创意脚本攥写，分镜绘制或Previs制作，输出清晰的前期方案给到后续环节生产指引；
3.负责在生产过程中把控内部及供应商团队工作，能输出专业清晰的反馈文档或直接自行制作解决核心卡点，确保项目有效推进和内容高品质落地；
4.与策划、美术及其他职能团队协作共同完成游戏内容创作，并能在过程中给到专业的视听方向建议帮助提升游戏整体视听表现；
5.参与项目游戏剧情过场及实机PV的生产管线搭建及维护更新，确保项目能够稳定、保质且高效的产出相应内容。

title: 《王者荣耀》2D美宣原画-colour key设定
jd_text:
1.负责绘制游戏展示动画中的灯光氛围及情绪变化的画面效果，即colour key绘制；
2.负责绘制游戏展示动画中的画面风格设计；
3.负责将游戏展示的特效设计稿和场景设计进行整合优化。

title: 快乐猴-湖州门店店长
jd_text:
1、确保公司营运标准高效在门店落地，提升销售与毛利；
2、理解商圈和用户，据此对门店品类和商品经营方向有清晰的认知，通过品类/商品经营、拉新、营销、门店布局、商品订货、陈列、服务，售后，库存管控等；
3、管控店内损耗、提升门店人效，优化可控费用（如物料，水电煤等营运费用），达成主要考核KPI；
4、对内各协同部门的日常高效交互，达成共识，高效执行总部和区域新项目落地；
5、对外关系的建立维护，如相关政府职能部门（市场管理、消协等）、物业关系，打造协作融洽的合作伙伴。 1、具有传统大型零售运营的思维模式，5年以上工作经验，担任过2年以上传统实体零售门店生鲜副店长及以上级别的管理岗,关注客户价值和客户体验;
2、诚实正直、品行端正、责任心强、肯吃苦、有激情且执行力强，有商人视角；
3、勇于承担，乐于分享，指导与培养团队各项能力，能够打造高绩效团队，形成阶梯化人才成长模式；
4、具备建设组织和体系搭建能力，可以制定并落实各环节的流程。
5、掌握基本的AI工具，具备数字化运营思维，能快速学习并应用AI辅助工具提升工作效率。

title: 食用油大宗贸易采购
jd_text:
1. 负责食用油大宗贸易的采购工作，包括供应商开发、价格谈判及合同签订。  
2. 分析市场行情与价格趋势，制定合理的采购策略以控制成本并保障供应稳定。  
3. 管理采购流程，协调物流、仓储及质量检验等环节，确保货物按时交付。  
4. 维护与国内外供应商的长期合作关系，评估供应商绩效并优化供应链结构。  
5. 协同销售、财务及风控团队，完成采购预算编制与风险管控工作。 1. 大学本科及以上学历，供应链管理、国际贸易、食品科学或相关专业优先。  
2. 具备5年以上大宗商品或食用油行业采购经验，熟悉国际贸易流程。  
3. 具备较强的市场分析能力、谈判技巧及成本控制意识。  
4. 熟练使用办公软件及ERP系统，具备良好的英语读写能力。  
5. 工作责任心强，具备良好的沟通协调能力。

dept.name: 人力资源平台

title: 美团外卖-供应链采购专家
jd_text:
1、寻商：基于用户需求预测，输出品类备货计划，根据上游菜品研发的食材清单要求和标准，寻找匹配需求的工厂、供应商。
2、菜品：联动菜品研发，与供应商研发对接，进行定品和议价，输出采购方案，持续推动商品统采。
3、议价：通过竞标等流程，拿到供应商最优价格，并持续原料采购价格优化。
4、供应商管理：联动品控，对合作商的产品做品质监督管理，保障商品稳定性，以及联动商管，通过商管政策对合作商继续做合规化管理，保障供应链的高效运转。 
5、履约仓储对接：对接供应商、仓配厂商，推动履约链路搭建，保障商品从工厂到门店的履约时效和效率、成本最优。 1、大学本科及以上学历。
2、在餐饮品牌、食材供应链平台等，从事零售3R大单品等优先，有采购经验。
3、有供应链资源。
4、具备创业精神，积极主动，有较强的自驱力。
